detail:
Decisions: [object Object]; [object Object]; Wrapped exchangeCommands and migrateCommands inside mirrorAll along with every other command set — withV3Mirror is a no-op for any name outside COMMAND_EVENT_MAP, so this is behaviour-neutral today and keeps the decoration uniform if a write command is ever added to those sets
Findings: test/unit/staleness.test.ts joins test/migrate/golden-fixture.test.ts and test/server-startup.test.ts as a whole-suite contention flake on this machine (real-filesystem + git probes); it passed alone immediately after failing in a full run. Worth adding to the documented flake list rather than diagnosing as breakage.; Both cross-lane defects found so far were invisible to per-lane suites and both trace to the same seam: lane 02b's ancestor-membership admission rule versus code written before that rule existed. Any lane code that mints an event without citing the policy it will be judged under is suspect.
summary: Merged lane/03-runtime into foundation/v3; resolved the events-verb collision between lanes 02c and 03, and fixed the signing ceremony producing rulings its own admission rule quarantined.
